description: Update a gameserver schedule (name, action, cron, runOnceAt, timezone, command, wipe options, isActive). isActive=false pauses it. A new cron or runOnceAt is local time in the schedule's own `timezone` (from list_gameserver_schedules) unless you also send `timezone`; omitting `timezone` keeps the schedule's zone. `runOnceAt` makes it a one-time schedule (a finished one runs again at the new time); a new `cron` (or runOnceAt=null plus cron) makes a one-time schedule recurring again. Re-enabling a finished one-time schedule needs a new runOnceAt. The daily auto backup (isSystem) cannot be changed. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

cron.description: Recurring schedule: five-field cron in local time of `timezone`, e.g. "0 4 * * *" = daily 04:00. At most every 5 minutes. Leave out for a one-time schedule (`runOnceAt`).

anyOf.description: One-time schedule: local date and time "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" in `timezone` (e.g. "2026-11-20T03:00"), in the future and at most one year ahead. Runs exactly once, then switches itself off (isActive=false). Use it for "once tomorrow at 3am", never a cron with a fixed day and month.

runOnceAt.description: One-time time "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" in the schedule's zone (or the new `timezone`): makes it a one-time schedule; a finished one runs again at the new time. null makes a one-time schedule recurring again (send `cron` with it). Omit to keep.

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

timezone.description: New IANA zone; omit to keep the schedule's zone (a pending one-time schedule keeps its local time), null resets to UTC.

wipe.description: Wipe options, required for action=wipe (only games with a wipe, e.g. Rust).

name: update_gameserver_schedule
title: Update Game Server Schedule
